purpose.zh: 练臀部，让腿往后抬更有力
purpose.en: Build your glutes for stronger backward leg lifts.

text.zh: 膝盖弯成直角，脚底往天花板推
text.en: Keep your knee bent at a right angle and push your sole up

text.zh: 双手和支撑的膝盖稳住，身体不动。
text.en: Keep your hands and supporting knee steady and your body still.
Keep your lower back from sagging and lower slowly.

commonErrors.en: Sagging the lower back to lift higher.

cautions.zh: 腰不舒服时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: If your lower back feels uncomfortable, reduce the range, and stop if it still hurts.

cautions.zh: 手腕刺痛或发麻时停止，开始前先活动手腕
cautions.en: Stop if your wrists feel sharp pain or numbness, and warm them up first.

changes: purpose 去掉「伸髋」；名字「四足」改「跪撑」
起止口令按 0.6/0.7 s 缩成 2 字/1 词；主口令「90度」改「直角」
